items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Joe Thomas, I met him and Earl (Al)Carruthers.

ctx.x: Baritone. I met him there. That was when I first ... We had a thing that happened and it ran from 12, I would allow for say, Stan, it ran from an hour, 11 to 4 and that's the way it worked. We had a very good band. It was a band, beat, good people,
melody and all that sort of thing. Joe Thomas, I met him and Earl (Al)Carruthers.
Now this Joe Thomas. Is he the brother of Fats Thomas?
